claim_boundary: Chapter 2 establishes conditional recurrence and unequal localization under existing public evidence. Chapter 3 may refine or falsify exact histories with own data, but a topology update is not independent replication of Chapter 2 and cannot by itself establish developmental integration, convergence, adaptation, mechanism or fitness benefit.
